rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the silver metal or the element itself.

example.english: This chain is made of pure silver.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lin6 hai6 seon4 ngan4 zou6 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing something that is shiny gray like silver.

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ngan4 sik1 ge3 ce1 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a twenty-fifth wedding anniversary rather than for a merely silver-colored object.

example.english: We are celebrating our silver wedding anniversary this year.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 hing3 zuk1 ngan4 fan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the shiny gray color, rather than the metal.

example.english: I want to buy a phone in silver.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 ngan4 sik1 ge3 din6 waa2
